target_customer: Real estate developers and their sales and marketing teams in Egypt and the wider Middle East
problem: Developers sell units through fragmented tools and agents. Sakneen provides a shared workspace for projects, inventory and sales workflows, pitched as Shopify for real estate developers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for developers, with plans to monetize transactions

founders.name: Ramy Khorshed
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as CEO Sakneen, Duke '14.

founders.name: Hussein Elkheshen
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder and CTO on the YC page (also spelled El Kheshen in press).

technical_complexity.rationale: A SaaS workspace for inventory and sales workflows, standard engineering for a small team, localized to Egyptian developer processes.

defensibility.rationale: Developers run inventory and sales on the platform and now name large Egyptian developers as customers, creating switching costs; early copyability was moderate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found. Consumer listing platforms such as Nawy and Aqarmap exist in Egypt but target buyers, not developer operations.

market_need_then: Egypt had a large developer led housing market and a cohort of proptech startups. Wamda (2021-02) reports a Coldwell Banker Egypt partnership in 2020-11. No other dated demand data was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional B2B tone; positions as operating system for real estate

brand_strength.rationale: Regional B2B brand with named developer customers such as Palm Hills and Tatweer Misr on its site, but no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Sakneen raised 150 thousand dollars from YC in 2020 and a 1.1 million dollar seed in 2021 led by Algebra Ventures, then no later round was found. It remains active and now lists large Egyptian developers as customers and claims systems managing over 20 billion dollars of annual sales. Egypt is a concentrated market and growth looks regional, so the venture outcome remains unproven.
notes: No rounds after 2021-02 found, so coverage is partial. The 150K pre-seed article was seen through search summaries only; the seed article was opened. Total funding stated as 1.25M in press. Competitors: Nawy and Aqarmap (consumer property platforms) surfaced in search but no source dated near the 2020 batch ties them to the developer software wedge, and the Wamda seed article names no competitors, so the list is empty. Name origin not found.
